requirement_text.REQ-425:
MOB-6 in docs/mobile/requirements.md (build-order M6; depends on M2). Built BEFORE MOB-4 (REQ-426..428) -- see the S9 header: the renderers' six states classify this requirement's ApiError. SECURITY-REVIEWER gate (refresh-token handling, token clearing).

Hardens lib/api/api_client.dart (created by REQ-421) into the single client:
1. Attach the active tenant's bearer token (REQ-422's iss check).
2. On 401: exactly one silent refresh via flutter_appauth's token refresh, then exactly one retry of the original request; concurrent 401s share one in-flight refresh. On refresh failure: clear the tenant's tokens (REQ-422 store) and route to login.
3. Exponential backoff on 5xx for idempotent methods only (GET), bounded attempts; POST is not auto-retried (no duplicate task completion).
4. Normalise every failure to a sealed ApiError type before it leaves lib/api/: at minimum network-unavailable, unauthorized, forbidden (403), not-found, module-not-available (a 404 on any /api/v1/modules/<id>/ path -- architecture.md §6: absence is 404, not 403, and must not render as a generic not-found), backpressure (429, carrying the Retry-After seconds -- the backend emits 429 from lib/letflow/plugs/admission.ex and lib/letflow/plugs/public_read_rate_limit.ex), validation (422 with RFC 9457 field errors), conflict (409), server (5xx after retries).
5. A static guard (apps/mobile/test/guards/), the counterpart of the SPA's raw-fetch-outside-client guard in web/tests/guards/: no file outside lib/api/ imports package:dio or package:http or uses dart:io HttpClient; with a self-test.

task.description:
WF-02 Step 5 for REQ-425. Independently re-run scripts/test_parallel.sh yourself -- do not trust TEST-RUNNER's report alone. Host memory has been borderline this run (last measured ~4.39GB before Step 4, dipping to ~3.47GB mid-run) -- re-check free memory yourself immediately before running and use TEST_PARALLEL_N=2 unless you measure comfortably above ~4GB free; fall back to serial mix test if still tight, and stop rather than retry a third time if reaped twice at the same settings. Also independently re-run flutter analyze && flutter test from apps/mobile/ yourself.

Confirm every one of REQ-425's 7 acceptance criteria is satisfied by checking the actual code/tests directly, not by trusting any prior step's summary -- this includes independently confirming SECURITY-REVIEWER's final PASS (step-02c-security-reviewer-recheck2.json) genuinely closed both cross-tenant token races found across its 3-cycle gate history, by reading the current apps/mobile/lib/api/api_client.dart yourself. Check docs/requirements.yaml and docs/status/requirement_status.v24.yaml for staleness relative to what actually shipped (REQ-425 should currently read status: in_progress, with a started event already appended -- DOC-UPDATER's Step 6, next, is what flips it to done).
acceptance_criteria: a test where the fake server returns 401 once then 200 asserts exactly one refresh call and exactly one retry, and that two concurrent requests both receiving 401 trigger one refresh total
a test where refresh fails asserts the tenant's tokens are deleted from the secure store and the router is at the login route

a test asserts a GET receiving 503 twice then 200 succeeds with increasing delays between attempts (fake clock), a GET receiving 503 on every attempt stops after the maximum attempt count declared as a named constant in lib/api/ and surfaces ApiError server (the test asserts the exact number of requests sent), and a POST receiving 503 is not retried

a test per ApiError variant asserts the mapping from status code/exception, including 404 on /api/v1/modules/exam/x -> module-not-available, 404 elsewhere -> not-found, and 429 with 'Retry-After: 7' -> backpressure(7 seconds)
a test asserts no DioException or SocketException escapes lib/api/ -- the public client API returns or throws only ApiError
the single-client guard fails its self-test fixture (a file under lib/features/ importing package:dio) and passes on the real tree
cd apps/mobile && flutter analyze && flutter test pass, real output quoted, and SECURITY-REVIEWER signs off before merge
